text: I couldn't agree more. That's exactly what I was thinking.
ipa: /aɪ ˈkʊdənt əˈɡriː mɔːr ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ wəz ˈθɪŋkɪŋ/
meaningVi: Tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý. Đúng y như điều tôi đang nghĩ.
example: A: We should leave early to avoid the traffic. — B: I couldn't agree more. That's exactly what I was thinking.

text: I see your point, but have you thought about the cost?
ipa: /aɪ siː jʊr pɔɪnt bʌt hæv juː θɔːt əˈbaʊt ðə kɔːst/
meaningVi: Tôi hiểu ý bạn, nhưng bạn đã tính đến chi phí chưa?
example: A: Let's hire two more people for the team. — B: I see your point, but have you thought about the cost?

text: I'm afraid I see it a little differently.
ipa: /aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪ siː ɪt ə ˈlɪtəl ˈdɪfrəntli/
meaningVi: Tôi e là mình nhìn nhận chuyện này hơi khác một chút.
example: A: The new policy is clearly a good idea. — B: I'm afraid I see it a little differently.

text: In my opinion, we should spend more time with our families.
ipa: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən wiː ʃʊd spɛnd mɔːr taɪm wɪð ˈaʊər ˈfæməliz/
meaningVi: Theo tôi, chúng ta nên dành nhiều thời gian hơn cho gia đình.
example: A: Everyone works too much these days. — B: True. In my opinion, we should spend more time with our families.

text: What do you think about working from home? Do you like it?
ipa: /wʌt duː juː θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ˈwɜːrkɪŋ frəm hoʊm duː juː laɪk ɪt/
meaningVi: Bạn thấy làm việc ở nhà thế nào? Bạn có thích không?
example: A: My company lets us work remotely now. — B: Really? What do you think about working from home? Do you like it?

text: I'm so sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do?
ipa: /aɪm soʊ ˈsɑːri tə hɪr ðæt ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ aɪ kən duː/
meaningVi: Mình rất tiếc khi nghe chuyện đó. Mình có giúp được gì không?
example: A: My grandmother is in the hospital. — B: I'm so sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do?

text: That must be really hard for you right now.
ipa: /ðæt mʌst biː ˈrɪli hɑːrd fɔːr juː raɪt naʊ/
meaningVi: Chắc lúc này bạn đang khó khăn lắm.
example: A: I lost my job last week. — B: Oh no. That must be really hard for you right now.

text: I'm so excited! I can't wait to see you next week.
ipa: /aɪm soʊ ɪkˈsaɪtɪd aɪ kænt weɪt tə siː juː nɛkst wiːk/
meaningVi: Mình háo hức quá! Mong đến tuần sau để gặp bạn ghê.
example: A: I just booked my flight to Hanoi! — B: I'm so excited! I can't wait to see you next week.

text: That's the best news I've heard all week!
ipa: /ðæts ðə bɛst nuːz aɪv hɜːrd ɔːl wiːk/
meaningVi: Đó là tin vui nhất mình nghe được cả tuần nay!
example: A: I passed my driving test! — B: That's the best news I've heard all week!

text: I'm a bit worried about my exam results, to be honest.
ipa: /aɪm ə bɪt ˈwɜːrid əˈbaʊt maɪ ɪɡˈzæm rɪˈzʌlts tə biː ˈɑːnɪst/
meaningVi: Nói thật là mình hơi lo về kết quả thi.
example: A: You seem quiet today. — B: I'm a bit worried about my exam results, to be honest.

text: Don't worry too much. I'm sure everything will be fine.
ipa: /doʊnt ˈwɜːri tuː mʌtʃ aɪm ʃʊr ˈɛvriθɪŋ wɪl biː faɪn/
meaningVi: Đừng lo quá. Mình tin là mọi chuyện rồi sẽ ổn thôi.
example: A: I have a job interview tomorrow and I'm nervous. — B: Don't worry too much. I'm sure everything will be fine.

text: I'm really fed up with the traffic in this city.
ipa: /aɪm ˈrɪli fɛd ʌp wɪð ðə ˈtræfɪk ɪn ðɪs ˈsɪti/
meaningVi: Mình phát ngán cảnh kẹt xe ở thành phố này rồi.
example: A: Why are you late again? — B: Sorry. I'm really fed up with the traffic in this city.

text: I'm really proud of you. You worked so hard for this.
ipa: /aɪm ˈrɪli praʊd əv juː juː wɜːrkt soʊ hɑːrd fɔːr ðɪs/
meaningVi: Mình thật sự tự hào về bạn. Bạn đã rất nỗ lực vì điều này.
example: A: I finally got the promotion! — B: I'm really proud of you. You worked so hard for this.

text: Honestly, I was kind of disappointed with the ending of the movie.
ipa: /ˈɑːnɪstli aɪ wəz ˈkaɪnd əv ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntɪd wɪð ði ˈɛndɪŋ əv ðə ˈmuːvi/
meaningVi: Thật lòng mà nói, mình hơi thất vọng với cái kết của bộ phim.
example: A: Did you enjoy the film? — B: Honestly, I was kind of disappointed with the ending of the movie.

text: I'm not a big fan of spicy food, but I'll try it.
ipa: /aɪm nɑːt ə bɪɡ fæn əv ˈspaɪsi fuːd bʌt aɪl traɪ ɪt/
meaningVi: Mình không mê đồ cay lắm, nhưng mình sẽ thử xem sao.
example: A: You have to try this chili soup! — B: I'm not a big fan of spicy food, but I'll try it.

text: I agree with you to some extent, but not completely.
ipa: /aɪ əˈɡriː wɪð juː tə sʌm ɪkˈstɛnt bʌt nɑːt kəmˈpliːtli/
meaningVi: Tôi đồng ý với bạn ở một mức độ nào đó, chứ không phải hoàn toàn.
example: A: Social media does more harm than good. — B: I agree with you to some extent, but not completely.

text: That's a good point. I hadn't thought about it that way.
ipa: /ðæts ə ɡʊd pɔɪnt aɪ ˈhædənt θɔːt əˈbaʊt ɪt ðæt weɪ/
meaningVi: Ý hay đấy. Mình chưa từng nghĩ theo hướng đó.
example: A: If we take the train, we can work on the way. — B: That's a good point. I hadn't thought about it that way.

text: I have mixed feelings about moving to a new city.
ipa: /aɪ hæv mɪkst ˈfiːlɪŋz əˈbaʊt ˈmuːvɪŋ tu ə nuː ˈsɪti/
meaningVi: Mình vừa mừng vừa lo khi chuyển đến sống ở một thành phố mới.
example: A: Are you excited about your move to Da Nang? — B: I have mixed feelings about moving to a new city.

text: I've been so stressed out lately with all this work.
ipa: /aɪv bɪn soʊ strɛst aʊt ˈleɪtli wɪð ɔːl ðɪs wɜːrk/
meaningVi: Dạo này mình căng thẳng quá vì cả đống việc này.
example: A: Want to grab a coffee? — B: Yes, please. I've been so stressed out lately with all this work.

text: I'm so glad everything worked out for you in the end.
ipa: /aɪm soʊ ɡlæd ˈɛvriθɪŋ wɜːrkt aʊt fɔːr juː ɪn ði ɛnd/
meaningVi: Mình mừng là cuối cùng mọi chuyện của bạn đều suôn sẻ.
example: A: The bank finally approved my loan. — B: I'm so glad everything worked out for you in the end.

text: If you ask me, that restaurant is a little overrated.
ipa: /ɪf juː æsk miː ðæt ˈrɛstərɑːnt ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl ˌoʊvərˈreɪtɪd/
meaningVi: Nếu hỏi mình thì quán đó được khen hơi quá lời.
example: A: Everyone says that place is amazing. — B: If you ask me, that restaurant is a little overrated.

text: I'm not so sure about that. Can you explain why?
ipa: /aɪm nɑːt soʊ ʃʊr əˈbaʊt ðæt kən juː ɪkˈspleɪn waɪ/
meaningVi: Mình không chắc lắm về điều đó. Bạn giải thích lý do được không?
example: A: Learning English after thirty is impossible. — B: I'm not so sure about that. Can you explain why?

text: I was so surprised when I heard they were getting married!
ipa: /aɪ wəz soʊ sərˈpraɪzd wɛn aɪ hɜːrd ðeɪ wɜːr ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈmærid/
meaningVi: Mình bất ngờ lắm khi nghe tin họ sắp cưới!
example: A: Did you know Tuan and Mai are engaged? — B: Yes! I was so surprised when I heard they were getting married!

text: I totally understand how you feel. I've been there too.
ipa: /aɪ ˈtoʊtəli ˌʌndərˈstænd haʊ juː fiːl aɪv bɪn ðɛr tuː/
meaningVi: Mình hoàn toàn hiểu cảm giác của bạn. Mình cũng từng trải qua rồi.
example: A: I feel so lonely since I moved abroad. — B: I totally understand how you feel. I've been there too.

text: I feel strongly that everyone deserves a second chance.
ipa: /aɪ fiːl ˈstrɔːŋli ðæt ˈɛvriwʌn dɪˈzɜːrvz ə ˈsɛkənd tʃæns/
meaningVi: Tôi tin chắc rằng ai cũng xứng đáng có thêm một cơ hội.
example: A: Should we let him rejoin the team? — B: Yes. I feel strongly that everyone deserves a second chance.
